messages:
joan: Quick heads-up  SableGrid agreed to be a customer spotlight. Interview set for Tue 5/9 11:00am PT. Need: legal quote approval, who owns recording + transcript, assets, and lead-routing for the demo CTA. Calendly: <https://calendly.example/sablegrid-spotlight>

alex: I can take recording + upload. Prefer Zoom cloud + local audio. Will schedule a 10-min mic check at 10:45.

mira: Design needs: hi-res headshots, transparent logo (svg/png), brand color hex, and any product screenshots. Need assets by Mon EOD to hit our timeline.

paul: Draft quote (please edit):
```
"SableGrid scaled inference into production in under 6 weeks using Redwood Dedicated, lowering per-request cost by ~62% and improving median latency by 48%."
```

tia: CS note: i'll validate the 62% and 48% with infra. If they're estimated we should use ~ or round. I'll confirm by Fri EOD.

samir: Legal: if we publish specific numbers we need written customer approval. Also avoid clinical/sensitive language. Send final quote + attestation here for review.

joan: Who owns pull quotes and the blog draft?

mira: I'll do pull quotes + social snippets. Joan, can you own the blog draft?

joan: Yep, I'll draft blog + 2-line webinar teaser after CS confirms numbers.

alex: Recording checklist: 1) Zoom cloud recording + local audio if guest ok; 2) Capture slides as PDF; 3) Otter.ai transcript export; 4) Save raw + trimmed to /marketing/assets/sablegrid/raw/; 5) Capture a 30s cut for paid social.

ops-bot: New meeting created: SableGrid Spotlight rehearsal  Tue 5/9 10:45am PT. Invite sent to participants.

paul: For launch plan  blog, short social reel (30s), and a webinar mention + demo CTA in the post. Need the webinar blurb and the landing slug.

tia: SDR ops request: route inbound demo signups to queue=central-sdr and tag campaign=sablegrid_q2. Also want utm params: utm_source=blog, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=sablegrid_q2.

mira: Can marketing ops spin up slug /demo/sablegrid-q2 and create SFDC campaign? If so, post the campaign id here.

samir: Legal note: If press outreach or embargoed release with PR, we need the signed attestation before outreach.

joan: Draft webinar blurb: "See how SableGrid reduced inference cost and stabilized latency to ship smarter features  join a short demo." Thoughts?

paul: Remove "smarter features"  too vague. Suggest: "See how SableGrid cut inference cost and stabilized latency for production apps  join a brief demo."

alex: Ill append utm params to the blog CTA and hand off the final URL to SDR ops once slug is live.

tia: SDR ops: can you confirm you can accept leads with campaign=sablegrid_q2 and tag source=blog?

samir: Once CS posts signed numbers + customer attestation I will approve the quote and legal sign-off here.

tia: Also want an automated nurture: 1x demo invite, 2x follow-up emails (3 and 7 days), and add registrants to webinar list. I'll draft copy.

joan: Timeline: Fri EOD  CS confirms numbers; Mon EOD  assets uploaded; Tue 10:45am  rehearsal; Tue 11:00am  recording; Thu  final edits to design; Fri  publish blog + social + open demo CTA.

paul: I'll post the final quote variants (short/medium/long) once CS confirms.

samir: Confirmed  I will review legal copy same day and post approval here.

alex: Tiny ask: can we also produce captions and a transcript for accessibility? Ill auto-gen captions and upload SRT to the asset folder.

mira: Yup, captions + 3 thumbnail options + 30s paid cut.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Legal review deadline  Fri 5/5 5:00pm PT.

joan: Great work team  I'll create the rehearsal invite, add a launch checklist to #launches, and draft the blog once numbers are final. :rocket:
